page.notes: Hebrew headwords and vowel points are read from a small scan and may be imperfect; those marked [?] are doubtful. Some Hebrew words in the Latin lines were transcribed as seen without vowel points where the points were not legible. The Latin "posteremo" appears as "postremò" in the scan; the printed form is kept as read. "abf." in the scan was read as "abs.". Stains and specks on the page are not transcribed.
